name: Music
desc: Play music from your phone via AirPlay

changes.summary: Cover art at once, and a Now playing box
points: A cover in the album's colors shows at once and the real cover fades in when it arrives - usually much sooner now
Covers you have seen before are remembered
A small Now playing box in the top corner when you leave Music while something plays (needs NotaTV 1.0.5)
Settings: protect OLED screens from burn-in (on by default)
Settings: choose where cover art comes from - Apple, MusicBrainz, or both with either one first
